information_rule: Each candidate is ranked from the mover rack and public information only: every possible last tile is enumerated from the public unseen pool (distribution minus board minus own rack) and weighted by multiplicity; per-world reply features are aggregated before the single forward pass; the actual last tile is consumed only when the chosen move is played. Every fresh decision re-ran the policy with the actual last tile swapped for an opponent-rack tile and required bitwise-identical inputs and the same choice.

training_data.labels: depth2 endgame search per candidate per public hypothetical last tile (previous study); per-tile margin and W/T/L with multiplicity retained in scenarios.csv

features.v1: opp greedy reply, mover greedy follow-up, full greedy playout (BEST_SMALL) per world
features.v2: opp best-scoring reply via exact lane-incremental WMP search (+2x mover rack if out), out flag, tiles, pass flag; mover BEST_SMALL greedy follow-up (score+2x opp rack if out), out flag; aggregated mean/std/min/max over worlds; plus one-ply value (after - mean opp value); 68 public candidate scalars (value-net scalars minus 4 history entries), static equity, spread after

model: MLP 1x128 ReLU -> scalar; within-root loss: root-demeaned Huber(margin/10) + listwise softmax CE (T=4); AdamW 1e-3, wd 1e-3, 25 epochs, batch 32 roots; seed 20261014
selection_on_stored_data: 4-fold grouped CV over all 2816 stored roots (whole roots per fold) plus out-of-fold completed games; old 512 test roots used diagnostically only

labeled.labels: peg1data depth2, same procedure, PGO build

full_games.note: seat-swapped pair per game id; static play outside the 1PEG; continuation static (0) or fixed two-ply endgame (2)

fresh_sets.overlap: no fresh board equals any stored (2816) or prior (896) 1PEG board; all fresh boards distinct

evaluation.paired: per root: policy choice vs static top-1, same actual last tile, common continuation; pair win score (W_p+1-W_s)/2, pair spread (M_p-M_s)/2; 10,000 bootstrap resamples of roots
evaluation.timing: single process, warm page cache, policy PGO build, 512 fresh roots, no other compute jobs
